title: Compare two coordinate reference systems without PROJ — geo_crs_equal

title: Report what is wrong with a GeoParquet file — geo_validate_parquet
text: One row per finding (design section 6.11), checks gpq validate makes GeoParquet 2.0 adds. Errors break specification: missing malformed geo key (geo_key_missing, geo_key_invalid, version_invalid, primary_column_invalid, columns_invalid, primary_column_not_in_columns), column entry breaks schema (encoding_invalid, geometry_types_invalid, crs_invalid, orientation_invalid, edges_invalid, bbox_invalid, epoch_invalid), geometry column missing, nested, repeated BYTE_ARRAY (column_missing, column_grouped, column_repeated, column_not_byte_array), 2.0 column without native type (native_type_missing) geo key (column_undeclared), geo key native type disagreeing (crs_mismatch, edges_mismatch, crs_key_missing). data scan adds WKB parse (wkb_invalid), types metadata list (geometry_type_undeclared), rings declared orientation (orientation_wrong), geometries outside geo key's bbox (bbox_exceeded), row groups whose native statistics miss data (statistics_exceeded, statistics_types).
